instruction.text: Select the E to learn more about a compass rose.
instruction.sound: Select the E to learn more about a compass rows.

end.text: Compass roses help you understand direction. The N stands for north, E for east, S for south, and W for west. Compass roses are often found on maps to give you a better understanding of where things are.

instruction.text: Select the label of the North Sea.

feedback.end: The blue parts of the map show water. Here you can see the North Sea, the English Channel and the Atlantic Ocean. Maps often use colour to show the differences between land and water.

instruction.text: Use the map to fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: This map shows the British Isles. To the west of the British Isles, you can find the ((++Atlantic_Ocean North_Sea)).
There are ((++5 2)) different capital cities in the British Isles.
On the map, you can see that ((++Edinburgh Dublin)) is the most northern capital city in the British Isles.
The city of ((Belfast ++London)) is directly east of Cardiff.

instruction.text: True or false? Choose the correct answer.

atoms.a: London is the furthest city to the east.
Cardiff is on the coast of the North Sea.
The W on a compass stands for south.
